test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

To take my parents on a pilgrimage by plane is **__one of the goal of my life__** after getting my first salary.

options.text: one of goal of my life
one of out of the goals of my life
one in the goal of my life
one of the goals of my life

solution:
The correct answer is **Option(4) i.e. "one of the goals of my life".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct formation of this phrase is
 
 
• **One + of + plural noun**……….. It indicates a selection.
 
 
 
• The phrase correctly implies that t**he goal mentioned is among multiple goals in a person's life**.
 
• The use of **"the goals"** correctly denotes plurality, syncing with **"one of"**.

**Therefore, the correct sentence is- *"To take my parents on a pilgrimage by plane is one of the goals of my life after getting my first salary."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Option 1** is incorrect due to the lack of definite article "the" before "goal" and incorrect singular form "goal".
 
• **Option 2 **is incorrect because "out of" is redundant and awkwardly placed.
 
• **Option 3** incorrectly uses "in" instead of "of", making the phrase grammatically incorrect.
